title: A · Counterfactual rewrite quality  [ann1]
label_config:
<!-- A_counterfactual (guideline v1.0). Goal: the user's assertion conflicts with the gold
     memory. Pass = (C1=Contradicts) ∧ (C2 ≥ 2).
     The false premise lives inside the utterance; the injected error is NOT shown separately. -->
<View style="max-width:760px; margin:0 auto; font-family:-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;">

  <View style="font-size:11px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:#7a56d6; margin-bottom:6px;">
    <Text name="_h1" value="Rewritten (counterfactual) utterance · spoken by $speaker_name — judge this"/>
  </View>
  <View style="background:#f2eefc; border-left:4px solid #7a56d6; border-radius:10px; padding:14px 16px; font-size:17px; line-height:1.5; color:#1f2330;">
    <Text name="rewritten" value="$rewritten"/>
  </View>

  <View style="background:#fafafb; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-radius:12px; padding:14px 16px; margin-top:14px;">
    <View style="font-size:11px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:#9096a1; margin-bottom:10px;">
      <Text name="_h2" value="Reference context"/>
    </View>
    <View style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:150px 1fr; row-gap:10px; column-gap:14px; align-items:start; line-height:1.5;">
      <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:13px;"><Text name="_l1" value="Original question"/></View>
      <View style="color:#1f2330;"><Text name="original_question" value="$original_question"/></View>
      <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:13px;"><Text name="_l2" value="Gold (true) answer"/></View>
      <View style="color:#1f2330; font-weight:600;"><Text name="gold_answer" value="$gold_answer"/></View>
      <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:13px;"><Text name="_l3" value="Subject speaker"/></View>
      <View style="color:#1f2330;"><Text name="speaker_name" value="$speaker_name"/></View>
      <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:13px;"><Text name="_l4" value="LoCoMo category"/></View>
      <View style="color:#1f2330;"><Text name="category" value="$category"/></View>
    </View>
    <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:12px; margin:12px 0 4px 0;"><Text name="_lm" value="Reference memory (what the assistant must retrieve)"/></View>
    <HyperText name="evidence_memory" value="$evidence_memory"/>
    <View style="color:#c2c6cf; font-size:11px; margin-top:10px;"><Text name="item_id" value="$item_id"/></View>
  </View>

  <View style="height:8px;"/>

  <View style="padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-radius:12px; margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="font-weight:600; color:#1f2330; margin-bottom:4px;"><Text name="_q0" value="Naturalness (1–5)"/></View>
    <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:12.5px; margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="nat_help" value="Would a real user plausibly send this? Judge as a conversation opener in a fresh chat — do NOT penalize for lacking prior context."/></View>
    <Choices name="naturalness" toName="rewritten" choice="single" required="true" showInLine="true">
      <Choice value="5" hint="Completely natural; indistinguishable from a real chat message"/>
      <Choice value="4" hint="Natural; minor awkwardness"/>
      <Choice value="3" hint="Acceptable; noticeably templated/stilted, yet still plausible"/>
      <Choice value="2" hint="Awkward; reads like a constructed test item"/>
      <Choice value="1" hint="Clearly artificial; no real user would send this"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <View style="padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-radius:12px; margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="font-weight:600; color:#1f2330; margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="_q1" value="C1 · Relation to gold — how does the asserted premise relate to the gold fact?"/></View>
    <Choices name="c1_relation" toName="rewritten" choice="single" required="true">
      <Choice value="Contradicts" hint="The asserted premise is incompatible with the gold fact"/>
      <Choice value="Consistent" hint="The premise actually matches the gold (no error was injected)"/>
      <Choice value="Orthogonal" hint="Talks past the gold fact; neither confirmed nor contradicted by it"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <View style="padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-radius:12px; margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="font-weight:600; color:#1f2330; margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="_q2" value="C2 · Plausibility of the false premise (1–3)"/></View>
    <Choices name="c2_plausibility" toName="rewritten" choice="single" required="true" showInLine="true">
      <Choice value="3" hint="Plausibly wrong: same type/category, a believable misremembering (2022↔2019)"/>
      <Choice value="2" hint="Somewhat plausible: statable by a user, but off-category or oddly specific"/>
      <Choice value="1" hint="Implausible: absurd/self-refuting; the utterance itself signals the error"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <View style="padding:12px 14px; margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:12.5px; margin-bottom:6px;"><Text name="_qc" value="Optional comment"/></View>
    <TextArea name="comment" toName="rewritten" rows="2" maxSubmissions="1"
              placeholder="Anything worth noting (optional)"/>
  </View>

</View>
